audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2, 3 and 4 read Skill / Teemo / Teemo while the whys on those exact rows say you poke ahead at 2, that 3 is a skillshot war, and that 4-5 stay even.
audit.why: The packet chart (Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Ziggs, Teemo, Teemo) matches the whys word for word; the on-disk chart matches nothing. The mirror recorded no point-2 correction, so aligning to the packet does not create a mirror disagreement.
audit.corrected: Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Skill / Ziggs / Teemo / Teemo — matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: The spike map is right: your window is Level 6 (Mega Inferno Bomb, 5000 range on 120/95/70) before shrooms accumulate, and Teemo's is first item onward as Noxious Trap range climbs 600/750/900 and its cost falls 75/55/35. spikes[1] and spikes[2] already say exactly that.
sources: kits: teemo R range 600/750/900 cost 75/55/35; ziggs R 5000 cd 120/95/70

audit.whatIsWrong: The page knows the blind hurts Short Fuse but understates it, and never states the range numbers that make the lane readable.
audit.why: A blinded attack still consumes the Short Fuse charge — the passive goes on cooldown and deals no damage — so the dart on your empowered auto costs you the whole proc, not just an auto. And the range picture is lopsided: Bouncing Bomb 850, Blinding Dart 680 on a flat 7 seconds, Teemo's attack range 500. Toxic Shot is a free on-hit poison, so his damage scales with attack speed rather than with anything armour answers.
audit.corrected: Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 against Blinding Dart's 680 and his 500 attack range, and a blinded Short Fuse still spends the charge for zero damage — trade with bombs and never bank the passive for a duel.
sources: kits: teemo Q range 680 cd 7, E onHit flag, R ranges; ziggs Q 850, P Short Fuse

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d offers a 'fifteen-second invitation' off Blinding Dart.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank — the page was promising twice the window that exists, on the one cooldown it tells you to count.
audit.corrected: It is back in 7 seconds, not fifteen.

edits.before: It's a range war: your Q out-ranges his auto blind, but his Q Blinding Dart shuts off your P Short Fuse auto-resets and his passive stealth lets him reposition — trade with Bouncing Bomb, not autos, and it comes down to who lands skillshots.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 against Blinding Dart's 680 and his 500 attack range — and a blinded Short Fuse still spends the charge for zero damage, so trade with bombs only and never bank the passive for a duel you meant to win with autos.

edits.before: Out-DPS you in trades with his auto-attack poison
edits.after: Stack attack speed — Toxic Shot rides on-hit

edits.before: Blinds your autos — trade with spells while it is up. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: A blinded Short Fuse auto still burns the charge — the passive goes on cooldown and deals nothing.

edits.before: Teemo burns Blinding Dart on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Teemo burns Blinding Dart on nothing — but it is back in seven seconds.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds your autos — trade with spells while it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Satchel has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: a flat 7 seconds at 680 range — it never touches your bombs, only your autos, so keep trading with spells straight through it. - Your W Satchel has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

notes: The prose here was already better than most of this champion's entries — it correctly identified the blind as a Short Fuse problem. Two things it got wrong: Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds, not the fifteen dosFull[2].d promised, and the interaction is worse than stated — a blinded attack still consumes the Short Fuse charge, so the passive goes on cooldown for nothing. That is the mirror's headline finding restated from this side, with the verified ranges (Q 850, dart 680, his autos 500). Chart rows 2-4 realigned to the packet chart, which is what all three of their own whys already described; the on-disk chart matched neither. The packet suspectName 'Your Mega Inferno Bomb' is a false positive. Also surfaced the on-hit point: Toxic Shot is a free on-hit poison scaling with attack speed, so armour reads the trade wrong.
